name: io.github.atabekdemurtaza/papyrio-mcp
title: Papyrio PDF Tools
description: Compress, convert, merge, split and OCR PDFs on your own machine. Reads and writes local files, so an assistant can chain operations without uploading and downloading between every step.

environmentVariables.name: PAPYRIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: RapidAPI subscription key. Without one the server runs on the free guest tier, which allows three operations a day per IP address.
